# RS Photography

> Corporate event photography and videography company in Singapore, serving corporate, MICE and government clients since 2013. Director: Ricky Ee. bizSAFE Level 3 certified; government agencies can engage RS Photography through GeBIZ. Not GST-registered: quotations are nett.
